title: Signal: Development tooling is treated as a runtime dependency
scope: A packages.config file that declares a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency.
limitations: It matches a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A packages.config that mentions a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
